scene: The brass vending machine hums softly, displaying strange glowing bottled goods.
picture: Close-up first-person view of the brass vending machine panel. On the far left sits an ornate coin slot. Centre rests a bright red turn dial beneath illuminated glass showing bubbling green soda. To the right, a weathered brass dispenser flap hangs partly open, revealing darkness within. Two denim cuffs frame the lower edge.

A chunky red turn dial sitting centre, just beneath a glass display.
